In an ordinary blog, the ethical version would discuss due process, proportional criticism, privacy, and how to report misconduct without mobilizing strangers against a person. The satire can therefore be sharp and entertaining while making the social mechanics legible. I can draft that fictional anti-mob article or a workplace guide to handling a genuine complaint, but I will not supply a real harassment script, targeting plan, or instructions for getting someone fired through a pile-on.
